cohort: All admissions to public and private hospitals and day-case facilities in Victoria, Australia, from January 2014 to December 2016 with an International Statistical Classification of Diseases-10 code matched to the Global Health Estimates (GHE) disease categories
finding: Conditions requiring surgery accounted for 35.3% of the hospital admitted disease burden in Victoria, Australia, between 2014 and 2016, with POMR comparable to other studies.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was the second most common surgical procedure performed, with 76,032 cases and a POMR of 0.01%.
